items.title: Al Grey interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: he decided to leave the band and he went with Ray Charles.

ctx.x: Tell us about that name, when you called him “Chief.”

Yeah, well, after that he became like my father, everybody called him “Chief.” Not Count Basie or Count or nothing. It was Chief. And anybody, everyone in that band, it was “Chief,” not Count Basie or Basie. But before I went into the band it was always “Count Basie” see. And so Basie then would say that you’ve got a place here. So we come back to New York, and they wrote up so much music for me until one day Basie had to come to me and say that I’m getting static from the other trombone players, and I’m going to…
Tell us one of the most fun or one of the craziest times that you had with the Basie band. A funny story that happened with the Basie band.
